description: This file defines classes and functions for fetching and processing OECD Composite Leading Indicator data, including query parameter validation, data transformation, and API request handling.

classes.name: OECDCompositeLeadingIndicatorQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for OECD Composite Leading Indicator data, including country selection, adjustment, and growth rate options with validation.

classes.name: OECDCompositeLeadingIndicatorData
classes.description: Represents the data structure for OECD Composite Leading Indicator data.

classes.name: OECDCompositeLeadingIndicatorFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and processing OECD Composite Leading Indicator data from the OECD API, including transforming queries and data.

methods.name: country_validate
methods.description: Validates the country input, allowing multiple countries and handling 'all' option.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into a validated query object, setting default start and end dates.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data from the OECD API, processes CSV response into structured data, and applies necessary transformations.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw API data into structured data objects.
